Property Description

Located in the well-managed SOLO building, this spacious 948 sq.ft. 2-bedroom + 2 bathroom offers abundant natural light and a thoughtful open-concept layout. The kitchen flows into the dining area, which features built-in cabinets . Enjoy access to top-notch amenities including a gym, lounge, and bike room—all in a prime Kitsilano location just steps from Connaught Park, boutique shopping, and trendy restaurants, coffee shops, Arbutus Greenway, schools, groceries, transit and future Arbutus Station and Broadway Subway Line. Great location.
